source: 1968 Chevrolet Chassis Service Manual, Heater and Air Conditioning, p.1A-1

procedures.title: Heater system: general description
notes: Heater parts mount on the right side of the firewall: blower, air inlet assembly and water hoses on the engine side; heater core and distributor duct on the passenger side.
The heater uses outside air only; the blower draws it from the cowl vent plenum chamber.
There is no water valve, so coolant flows through the core and keeps it hot at all times.
Airflow is set by three doors in the distributor duct: Air, Temperature and Defroster (see figure 1 in the manual).
